metadata.tool: Scotland Yard Live Board Calibration Tooling
metadata.evidence_audit_note: Audit confirms that complete.jpeg is 1280x892 with SHA-256 2B1B33BB430F57BD29F7EBE4BEB978BC662C9B5E56DFBFBC0F4D40C8F3264E33. The previous textual reference to 1280x960 in the Phase 3C.3-B response was an erroneous narrative typo; the calibration scripts have strictly processed the exact 1280x892 repository file. No source image has been resized, cropped, or replaced.

images.board_orientation: Inverted / rotated 180 degrees relative to upright board. The River Thames is at the top of the photo; Regent's Park is at the bottom; Tower of London is at the left; Hyde Park is at the right.
images.evidentiary_role: Global geometric reference; all four board corners and fold seam are visible.
images.known_limitations: Modest resolution (1.4 Mpx); ~2.2 px/mm; mild perspective tilt; top edge grazes the camera frame; board lies on patterned fabric.

images.board_orientation: Rotated 90 degrees counter-clockwise relative to upright board. Covers North-West quadrant: stations 1-114, Regent's Park, London Zoo, Hyde Park North.
images.evidentiary_role: High-resolution local reference for North-West quadrant.
images.known_limitations: Cropped; rotated; no board corners in frame; perspective distortion.

images.board_orientation: Rotated 90 degrees counter-clockwise relative to upright board. Covers North-East quadrant: stations 4-107, King's Cross, St Paul's, City of London, Tower.
images.evidentiary_role: High-resolution local reference for North-East quadrant.
images.known_limitations: Cropped; rotated; perspective distortion; right edge partially visible.

images.board_orientation: Rotated 90 degrees counter-clockwise relative to upright board. Covers South-West quadrant: stations 113-197, Chelsea, Kensington, Battersea, West Thames.
images.evidentiary_role: High-resolution local reference for South-West quadrant.
images.known_limitations: Cropped; rotated; perspective distortion; left board edge visible.

images.board_orientation: Rotated 90 degrees counter-clockwise relative to upright board. Covers South-East quadrant: stations 113-200, Southwark, Lambeth, Kennington, station 200.
images.evidentiary_role: High-resolution local reference for South-East quadrant; confirms station 200 marker.
images.known_limitations: Cropped; rotated; perspective distortion; lower title border visible.
